Tokyo only needs a reconcile (71 vs ~45). Bouldeer city names in the tool are ward names, so city counts above are approximate.

indicative_gap.basis: Not quantifiable: no national total. Qualitative only: sample ratio 0.42 (Seoul 4/7, provincial cities 7/19), but the blog lists are old, mix in outdoor/municipal walls, and Korean names were matched to Bouldeer's romanised names by hand (match risk both ways). If the sample were representative the implied national total would be roughly 290 (123/0.42), which is only a cross-check, not a count. Bouldeer also lacks several The Climb / Seoul Forest Climbing branches (The Climb group ~10 sites, Bouldeer 5; Seoul Forest Climbing 5 sites, Bouldeer 1).

countries.notes: Bouldeer's 123 already looks thorough outside the chain gaps; potential gap probably moderate (tens to ~150) but unproven. Re-check with a Naver Map region count (Seoul, Gyeonggi first) before committing a section; closing the The Climb / Seoul Forest Climbing branch gaps is a cheap first step.
